exposure: airway inflammatory markers (LPS, CXCL8, CCL5, IL-6, IL-13)
cohort: Seventy-four infants hospitalized for an initial episode of severe RSV bronchiolitis at 6 months of age or less at Beijing Children's Hospital.
finding: Higher abundance of Haemophilus, Moraxella, and Klebsiella in the airway microbiome, along with elevated airway levels of LPS, CXCL8, CCL5, IL-6, and IL-13, were significantly associated with the development of recurrent wheezing by age 3 in infants with severe RSV bronchiolitis.
